entities.name: Mária Frank
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mária Frank was a Hungarian swimmer who won a bronze medal in the 4 × 100 m freestyle relay at the 1962 European Aquatics Championships. She finished fourth in the same event at the 1960 and 1964 Summer Olympics.
